description:
A numerology reading as an A4 PDF (default), HTML or Markdown: Life Path, Expression, Soul Urge, Personality, Birthday and Maturity with what each position measures and the meaning of its number, the Balance number, the four pinnacles and challenges with their ages, and the personal year. Same engine and meanings as /numerology/{system}/*, five systems. The name must be in Latin letters (diacritics are dropped); any other letter is refused with 400 `NAME_NOT_LATIN` rather than counted as zero. No AI. Texts in Ukrainian or English; any other language gets the English document.

[Group: Reports]
[Endpoint: POST /v1/reports/numerology]
[Required: name, date]
[Cost: 5,000 credits (Tier 7)] ⚠️ Premium — ~50% of free monthly budget. Confirm with user before invoking.

format.description: `pdf` (default) stores a PDF and answers with its `url`. `html` returns one self-contained `text/html` document, `markdown` returns `text/markdown` with the same sections and tables; neither is stored. Same price in every format.

name.description: Full name in Latin letters; the letter tables hold A to Z. Diacritics are dropped, any other letter is refused with 400 NAME_NOT_LATIN.

system.description: Letter table and master-number rule, as /numerology/{system}/*. Default pythagorean.

headingColor.description: Colour of the divider rule under each section heading (not the heading text, which is themeColor).

themeColor.description: Accent colour, used for section heading text and inline emphasis.

year.description: Year of the personal-year chapter. Defaults to the current year (UTC).

name: astroway_reports_numerology
title: Generate Numerology Report (PDF or HTML)
